mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (measured by the 3-month change in FEDFUNDS) predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as lower discount rates boost equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months with a 3-month decline in FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPIAUCSL inflation exceeds 3.5%, it triggers central bank tightening expectations that predict negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months with CPIAUCSL > 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) combined with declining industrial production (INDPRO) signals concurrent labor market deterioration and manufacturing contraction, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months where UNRATE rises >0.1pp and INDPRO falls >0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: During housing market expansions (HOUST > 1400 thousand units), a rising trend in housing starts (measured by 1-month change in HOUST) predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months with HOUST > 1400 and HOUST increase >0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 110 for two consecutive months, it signals manufacturing contraction that predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months with two consecutive INDPRO readings below 110.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 4.8%, it signals labor market deterioration that predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months with UNRATE > 4.8%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 1 month predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as immediate rate cuts boost short-term equity sentiment.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months with a 1-month decline in FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential investment (RSAFS) over the past 3 months predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as housing sector strength supports consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of quarters with a 3-month increase in RSAFS.
